in_marathi.name: Rishitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rishitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of knowledge and wisdom, Rishitha is a Sanskrit word derived from the root words ‘Rishi’ meaning sage and ‘Tha’ meaning mother. It is believed that a child named Rishitha will possess immense wisdom and intelligence.
